note: The one developed campground in Del Norte Coast Redwoods SP (part of Redwood National and State Parks), 2 mi east of US-101 in second-growth redwood and alder along Mill Creek, in a Southern (sites 1-74) and a Northern (sites 75-145) loop. Narrow lanes and tight curves limit trailers to 24 ft; ReserveCalifornia lists most campsite pads at 24 ft. --Claude
summary: Mill Creek (Del Norte Coast Redwoods): $35 every date read (Dec 2026 - Sep 2027), max motorhome 28 ft / trailer 24 ft (park page and NPS), no hookups, showers, dump, water; 2027 RC season May 28 - Sep 30. Creekside kept (map + lidar valley floor; canopy hides the bank). Phone (707) 464-6101 to add.
flags: WATERFRONT: creekside KEPT. Mill Creek (a small stream, well under 30 m) runs through the campground: the 2019 park map draws it between the loops, along the outer east side of the Southern loop by sites 44-47 and 56-68, and along the west side of the Northern loop by 114-121. Both loops are under continuous canopy on Esri imagery, so the bank can't be seen; USGS 3DEP lidar puts the loops on the creek's flat valley floor (115-117 m along an EPQS transect at 41.6995), with no terrace or bluff between, so an easy walk down is consistent. Site points are not published (RC MapInfo has no coordinates), so distances are from the not-to-scale map.
